description: Game programming. Feature work, gameplay systems, bug fixes, and the engine-side integration of art, music and sound effects. This is the workflow that writes code players run.
when_to_use: something in the game has to behave differently
a feature, system or fix is being implemented
engine-side wiring is needed for an asset or a system
avoid_when: the request is about what to build rather than building it
the work is purely producing asset files
the code is for the team's tooling rather than the game
